python3 << 'EOF'
# NASA outlay data from FY 2008-2017 (in millions)
# From 2012 bulletin: FY 2008-2012
# From 2017 bulletin: FY 2013-2017

nasa_outlays = {
    2008: 17834,
    2009: 19168,
    2010: 18906,
    2011: 17617,
    2012: 17190,
    2013: 16978,
    2014: 17093,
    2015: 18272,
    2016: 18828,
    2017: 18698
}

# Convert to billions
values = [v/1000 for v in nasa_outlays.values()]
print("NASA outlays (billions):")
for year, val in nasa_outlays.items():
    print(f"  {year}: {val/1000:.3f}")

print("\nSorted values (billions):")
sorted_vals = sorted(values)
print(sorted_vals)

# 10% Winsorization for n=10
# 10% of 10 = 1 value to cap at each end
# Lower bound: cap at 10th percentile value
# Upper bound: cap at 90th percentile value

# 10th percentile: between index 0 and 1, use value at index 1 (10th percentile roughly)
# Actually for Winsorization, we use the value at position 10% * n = 1
# Lower bound = value at index 1 after sorting
# Upper bound = value at index len-2 = index 8 after sorting

lower_percentile = sorted_vals[1]  # 2nd smallest (10th percentile position)
upper_percentile = sorted_vals[-2]  # 2nd largest (90th percentile position)

print(f"\n10th percentile value: {lower_percentile}")
print(f"90th percentile value: {upper_percentile}")

# Winsorize
winsorized = []
for v in values:
    if v < lower_percentile:
        winsorized.append(lower_percentile)
    elif v > upper_percentile:
        winsorized.append(upper_percentile)
    else:
        winsorized.append(v)

print(f"\nWinsorized values: {winsorized}")
print(f"Min: {min(winsorized):.4f}, Max: {max(winsorized):.4f}")

# Range = max - min
winsorized_range = max(winsorized) - min(winsorized)
print(f"\n10% Winsorized range: {winsorized_range:.4f} billion")
print(f"Rounded to hundredths: {winsorized_range:.2f}")
EOF

    2013: 16978,
    2014: 17093,
    2015: 18272,
    2016: 18828,
    2017: 18698
}

# These are already the total outlays (on + off budget combined)
# Convert to billions
values = [v/1000 for v in nasa_outlays.values()]

print("NASA total outlays (billions) FY 2008-2017:")
for year, val in nasa_outlays.items():
    print(f"  {year}: ${val/1000:.3f}B")

# 10% Winsorization for n=10
# 10% of 10 = 1, so cap 1 value at each end
sorted_vals = sorted(values)
print(f"\nSorted values: {sorted_vals}")

# Lower bound = 10th percentile = position 1 (0-indexed)
# Upper bound = 90th percentile = position 8 (0-indexed)
lower = sorted_vals[1]
upper = sorted_vals[-2]
print(f"10th percentile: {lower}")
print(f"90th percentile: {upper}")

# Winsorize
winsorized = [max(lower, min(upper, v)) for v in values]
print(f"\nWinsorized values: {winsorized}")

# Range = max - min after Winsorization
winsorized_range = max(winsorized) - min(winsorized)
print(f"\n10% Winsorized range: {winsorized_range:.4f} billion")
print(f"Rounded to hundredths: {winsorized_range:.2f}")

# Write to answer.txt
with open('/app/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"{winsorized_range:.2f}")

print("\nWritten to /app/answer.txt")
EOF
